newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P cuts Alcatel Alsthom debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P cuts Alcatel Alsthom debt ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Tuesday it had lowered its ratings on the long-term and short-term debt of Alcatel Alsthom, removing them from CreditWatch.
In a statement, the rating agency also said the outlook for the long-term debt was "stable."
S&P said it lowered the rating on the long-term debt to "A+" from "AA-" and the rating on the short-term debt to "A-1" from "A-1+."
The ratings cuts reflect "the challenges Alcatel Alsthom faces to restore sufficient operating profitability and cashflow in very competitive market conditions," the statement said.

S&P also said the ratings anticipate an improvement in consolidated operating profit margin to up to some eight percent of turnover in the medium-term and the continuation of a cautious financial policy.
